hypothesis: The official TrackMan pitch sequence contains a target-free view of a pitcher's typical within-appearance workload. Current inning alone cannot distinguish a starter near pitch 80 from a reliever near pitch 8. A frozen pitcher-by-inning workload profile can expose that distinction to exact-C without using target-season TrackMan rows or any other evaluation row.

relationship_to_prior_work.pitcher_profile: The earlier main-table profile summarized inning usage only. It did not reconstruct pitch index within a pitcher appearance from TrackMan game_id and pitch_no.
relationship_to_prior_work.recent_denominators: That feature reconstructed prior-game opportunity counts from rounded official rates. It did not estimate the current appearance's workload position.
relationship_to_prior_work.trackman_rich: Exact-C already uses completed-history physical means and pitch mix. This candidate adds only sequence-derived workload features and leaves the physical profile unchanged.

fixed_feature_recipe.source_rows: conservatively linked official TrackMan rows with game_type R and season strictly before the predicted row season
fixed_feature_recipe.appearance_order: ascending numeric pitch_no with stable mergesort
fixed_feature_recipe.appearance_pitch_index: one plus zero-based cumcount within appearance_key
fixed_feature_recipe.supported_innings: union of observed integer innings and fixed integers 0..20

cell_shrinkage.prior: the matching league-wide inning value, with league overall fallback

fixed_feature_recipe.unknown_pitcher: use the frozen league inning prior; set both unseen flags to one
fixed_feature_recipe.known_pitcher_unknown_inning_cell: use the frozen league inning prior; set cell_unseen to one

fixed_model_recipe.drop_features: pitcher_id plus every e58 pitch-group-specific rate and physical mean; exact list must equal v3_sparse_c_backtest
fixed_model_recipe.candidate_route: For every comparison baseline, blend the workload model on R rows only; preserve that comparison baseline exactly on F rows.

development.ranking: maximum minimum full-score gain across both years and all comparisons; then maximum minimum R gain; then smaller gamma
development.on_fail: Close this recipe without fitting or reading a 2024 workload candidate.
development.on_pass: Write an immutable confirmation lock before fitting 2024; no feature, model, route, gamma, or shrinkage changes are permitted.
